explanation_short: KNN is the best model, achieving the highest R² (0.81717) and lowest RMSE (0.11318), while DT performed the worst.
explanation_full: The model comparison clearly shows that KNN is the superior model, evidenced by its highest R² score (0.81717) and lowest RMSE (0.11318). In contrast, the DT model performed the poorest, recording the lowest R² (0.56045) and highest RMSE (0.17548). Among the remaining models, RF (R²=0.77560) outperformed XGBoost (R²=0.74948) and SVM (R²=0.73241), indicating a stronger predictive capability.
